issues.quote: Net income grew 5.4% to $70.9 billion in fiscal 2022 from $94.7 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: Apple's fiscal 2022 net income was $99.8 billion, not $70.9 billion. The 5.4% growth from $94.7B matches $99.8B. As written, $70.9B would be a drop of about 25%, which contradicts the word 'grew'.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, but it has one wrong figure. Fiscal 2022 net income was $99.8B, not $70.9B. That figure also clashes with the 5.4% growth rate the analysis gives. Revenue, gross profit and margin, operating income and margin, EPS, and R&D all match Apple's reported numbers.
